data.text:
Sanjay Singh vs Smt. Anita Singh, Commissioner Food ... on 11 
January, 2024 
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:3423
Court No. - 19
Case :- Contempt Application (Civil) No. - 4238 of 2023
Applicant :- Sanjay Singh 
Opposite Party :- Smt. Anita Singh, Commissioner Food Safety And Drug Admin. Lko. 
Counsel for Applicant :- Mahendra Pratap Singh Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Sri Mahendra Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the order dated 03.10.2023 passed by the writ court has been complied with. 
In view of the aforesaid, no contempt is made out. 
Notices are discharged Hence, contempt petition is dismissed. 
Consigned to records. 
Order Date :- 11.1.2024 Mayank  Sanjay Singh vs Smt. Anita Singh, Commissioner Food ... on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164014959/
